name: Bookoff Group Holdings Limited
summary: Bookoff Group Holdings Limited operates secondhand book and other goods stores in Japan, Malaysia, and the United States. It operates through Domestic BookOff Business, Premium Service Business, and Overseas Business segments. The company purchases and sells books, CDs, DVDs, games, hobby items, and mobile phones through BOOKOFF, BOOKOFF PLUS, BOOKOFF Official Online Store, and Asoviva. The company also provides premium purchasing services through hugall and aidect, jewelry order and reform services through Rehello by BOOKOFF, and trading card specialty businesses through Japan TCG Center.
